quotes.text: Best night out in Philly! The boat is nice and spacious, crew and captain attentive and kind. Everything went perfectly. I loved the DJ and had a blast dancing and enjoying the open bar. The food was incredible and tasted so good. Couldn't have asked for a better experience.

We had an amazing time! The staff was top-notch! We had the best time! Music, Food, Fireworks, GREAT views, and being on the water to top it off. What more could you ask for! Oh, did I mention the price so worth every penny! Can not wait to do this again! Highly recommend!

Amazing staff! They made our voyage so much fun. My party of 10 had an awesome time and the fireworks made it even better. The two lower decks were air conditioned and the top deck was open to feel the wonderful breeze. I would recommend booking a trip! We loved it.

I took my mom on the Sunday afternoon cruise. She loved it so much we are going back ASAP.. The appetizers were good. The whole experience was wonderful! Food, music, water and sunshine. What more could you ask for?
